messages:
kevin: kicking off staged canary for r-2026.05.10-rc1 -> 3 waves (5% each). deploy id=20260510-rc1. will request stop/go per wave.
deploy-bot: wave1 (5%) started in eu-north. variant=r-2026.05.10-rc1. logs: https://redwood.internal/deploy/20260510-rc1
sre-rita: quick check: p50 fine but p99 for embeddings climbed ~320ms in eu-north after wave1. small bump in 502s. dashboard: https://dash/reports/6450001111
ivy: seeing mem.rss increase on embed workers and one OOM restart on pod-112. build includes new tokenizers+vector-cache change.
kevin: hold wave2. deploy-bot on hold. can we triage quickly?
ops-bot: safety-latch enabled by ivy: pause_on_p99>300ms, max_wave_increment=0, notify=#eng-releases.
sre-rita: propose split routing: route embeddings back to previous stable in-region while leaving other routes on rc1. avoids full region rollback.
ivy: agree. command to ops: `/ops route-split --region eu-north --service=embeddings --target=v2026-05-02 --note "mem-regression"`
deploy-bot: applying route-split: embeddings->v2026-05-02, other services remain on r-2026.05.10-rc1.
sre-rita: after split: p99 dropped back near baseline, 502s fell. good signal.
kevin: cancel automated rollback for eu-north. `/deploy cancel 6450001111-rollback`
deploy-bot: rollback timer canceled by human.
ivy: opening incident INC-2026-900 (owner: ivy). notes: memory regression in embed pipeline from tokenizer+cache change; mitigation: regional embed pin, kv purge, add mem-delta preflight.
kevin: updating release notes: "eu-north: embeddings pinned to v2026-05-02 due to memory regression in r-2026.05.10-rc1; other traffic remains on rc1. Investigating tokenizer + vector-cache changes."
sre-rita: follow-ups: add embed-only canary stage, add CI mem-regression test, add preflight check for vector-cache alloc delta >10%.
kevin: we'll proceed with wave2 in other regions but keep eu-north locked for embeds. keeping stop/go open 12h. thanks all."
